pluginText.pf.rules: {"contract":"A written contract for a new roof where the state's rules require one, signed by everyone on title and by the business before any money","contract_parts":"The parts the state's form lists (license number, price, dates, deposit, cancel notice, any lien or recovery-fund notice, who owes the deductible)","cancel_window":"A cancel window after signing, where the state's rules give one; a longer one for contracts signed in a declared emergency, where the rules say so. Work and orders wait for it.","claim_denied":"A contract signed before the insurer decides: any right to cancel after a written denial, where the state's rules give one","insurance_claims":"The business never files, adjusts or explains the customer's claim, unless the state's rules allow it; no gifts or rebates tied to an inspection or a claim","permits":"Pulled by the license holder in the business's name, never the homeowner's","notice_before_work":"Any notice the state's rules require before work starts, filed by the owner of the business","change_orders":"Written and signed by both before added work, past what the contract already OK'd","final":"The city's final inspection before the balance is asked for","lien_release":"A lien release with the final payment, where the state's rules provide one","show":"The license number on the listing, the times read out, the confirmation, the estimate, the contract and the receipt, where the state's rules require it","storm_prices":"Prices from before a declared emergency, for as long as the state's rules say","warranty":"10 years on a new roof's workmanship and 1 year on repairs (the example's); the shingle maker's warranty registered in the owner's name","records":"7 years"}
pluginText.pf.edges: {"weather":"No tear-off at a 40% chance of rain or more (the example business's own limit); a weather move never costs the customer","wet_roof":"Rain at inspection time: a drone and attic look, or a new time","leak_gets_worse":"Safety steps first, then the emergency tarp offered with Sam's OK and a written price","hidden_damage":"Rotted decking: at the contract's price per sheet, inside the count OK'd; past it, a signed change order first","insurance_wait":"The estimate waits on the customer's insurer until its good-until date, with one reminder","insurance_check":"The balance may wait for the insurer's check: Sam picks wait or call","deductible_offer":"A customer or a door-knocker offers a deductible deal: answered with the plug-in's rule, never paid, waived or rebated","declared_emergency":"The owner says which licenses lapsed, newcomers held until the owner says yes, storm-period contracts marked, prices from before it","permit_late":"The install moves with no fee; the customer is told","inspection_fails":"The crew fixes it and it's checked again; the balance waits","nobody_home":"Install days: start and day-end photos","over_license_limit":"Not offered, and the owner is told why","other":"All other edge cases are handled the generic way"}
